_note: Announcement bars for www.shoonyadance.com, abcdans.com and swapnil.dance. ONE file for all three, published at https://links.shoonyadance.com/announcements.json and painted by announce-bar.js. On any day each site shows the APPROVED message with the lowest priority number whose from..until window contains today (Europe/Brussels, both ends inclusive). No live message = no bar. Every date must come from its owner file (semester-config.json, the event's facts JSON) — never typed from memory. /stale-watch checks this file weekly with scripts/announce-check.mjs and drafts the next message as approved:false; only Swapnil flips approved to true.

_schema.until: YYYY-MM-DD or null (= open-ended; must then carry until_status)
_schema.until_status: why until is null — UNVERIFIED <what is missing>, or EVERGREEN
_schema.text: { nl, en } — the bar picks by <html lang>; missing language falls back to the other
_schema.source: owner file the dates were read from
_schema.approved: true only after Swapnil said yes in chat

shoonya.until_status: UNVERIFIED — autumn 2026 registration close date is not in semester-config.json; ask Swapnil
